tagline: Your week, served with a side of sarcasm.
verdict: A good, busy week: three teams agreed an order for a migration nobody wanted to start, and a stack of small fixes is waiting for review.

sections.title: Starter
sections.text: A migration two teams each thought belonged to the other ended up with a plan by Wednesday. Writing it down counts as volunteering.

sections.title: Main
sections.text: Small accounts first, large ones later, and the dates shared early. The rollout calendar appeared within a day.

sections.title: Burnt bits
sections.text: A pile of fixes is still waiting for a reviewer. Somebody has not been told yet.

sections.title: Leftovers
sections.text: The cut-over dates meet reality next week.

sections.title: Compliments to the chef
sections.text: Three teams agreeing an order, and a plan someone could build from.

sections.title: Chef's notes
sections.text: Name a reviewer for each fix. Rehearse one cut-over date.
